flagship_project.name: Project BioRing-Synapse: Real-Time Continuous Multi-Biomarker Synthesis, Sub-Second Glucose-Metabolism Telemetry & Preventative Longevity Coach
flagship_project.pillar: Continuous Human Biomarker Telemetry & Autonomous Preventative Longevity Engine
flagship_project.strategic_thesis: Wearables usually report passive historical data. BioRing-Synapse unites PPG optical heart rate sensors, skin temperature, continuous glucose monitors (CGM), and blood panel biomarkers into a continuous predictive metabolic engine that gives actionable real-time interventions before glucose crashes or circadian disruptions occur.
flagship_project.tech_stack: C / Embedded C (Low-Power Bluetooth Ring Firmware), Swift / Kotlin (Native Mobile SDKs), Rust (Biomarker Ingestion Pipeline), TimescaleDB / ClickHouse, Python (Physiological Neural Models), Redis Enterprise
flagship_project.kpis: Sub-50ms real-time biomarker anomaly alerts; 6-day ring battery life maintained; predictive glycemic response with 94.2% accuracy.
